Schulz’s beloved Peanuts characters.

value.title: Fury
value.description: April, 1945. As the Allies make their final push in the European Theatre, a battle-hardened army sergeant named Wardaddy (Brad Pitt) commands a Sherman tank and her five-man crew on a deadly mission behind enemy lines. Outnumbered and outgunned, and with a rookie soldier thrust into their platoon, Wardaddy and his men face overwhelming odds in their heroic attempts to strike at the heart of Nazi Germany.
value.heroDescription: Director David Ayer delivers a visceral and vivid view of the WWII battlefront.

value.title: Good Will Hunting
value.description: The most brilliant mind at America’s top university isn’t a student...he’s the kid who cleans the floors. Will Hunting is a headstrong, working-class genius who’s failing the lessons of life. After one too many run-ins with the law, Will’s last chance is a psychology professor who might be the only man who can reach him.
value.heroDescription: Matt Damon and Ben Affleck’s co-written underdog drama is a certified classic.

value.title: Insomnia
value.description: Academy Award winners Robin Williams, Al Pacino and Hilary Swank star in a thriller set in the land of the midnight sun, where a the mind of even a tough cop can be threatened by Insomnia. Under the glare of the permanent Alaska sun, two veteran Los Angeles police officers close in on their suspect in the murder of a teenage girl. But when officer Will Dormer (Pacino) accidentally shoots his partner, their murder suspect, reclusive novelist Walter Finch (Williams), witnesses the shooting--and blackmails Dormer. Now, as an idealistic local detective (Swank) investigates the case, and the stakes rise, Dormer's sanity begins to falter.
value.heroDescription: Al Pacino’s sleepless cop is pushed to the edge by Robin Williams’ diabolical killer.

value.title: Tropic Thunder
value.description: Ben Stiller, Jack Black and Robert Downey Jr. lead an ensemble cast in "Tropic Thunder," an action comedy about a group of self-absorbed actors who set out to make the most expensive war film. After ballooning costs force the studio to cancel the movie, the frustrated director refuses to stop shooting, leading his cast into the jungles of Southeast Asia, where they encounter real bad guys.
value.heroDescription: A Hollywood set becomes a literal battleground in this riotous war-movie spoof.

value.title: 28 Days Later
value.description: An infirmary patient awakens from a coma to an empty room...in a vacant hospital...in a deserted city. A powerful virus, which locks victims into a permanent state of murderous rage, has transformed the world around him into a seemingly desolate wasteland. Now a handful of survivors must fight to stay alive, unaware that the worst is yet to come...
value.heroDescription: Director Danny Boyle’s brash and brutal style rewrote the rules for zombie movies.

value.title: Black Hawk Down
value.description: Black Hawk Down is the action packed true harrowing account of US Military action in Mogadishu, Somalia. As part of a UN Peacekeeping force, a group of elite US soldiers undertake a mission to abduct several top lieutenants of a Somalian warlord to stop the civil war that has been tearing the country apart. The carefully planned mission goes terribly wrong, resulting in the US military's single biggest firefight since Vietnam. From famed action producer Jerry Bruckheimer and acclaimed action director Ridley Scott.
value.heroDescription: Chaos and confusion reign in Ridley Scott’s pulse-pounding war film.

value.title: The Girl With the Dragon Tattoo
value.description: Disgraced financial reporter Mikael Blomkvist (Daniel Craig) finds a chance to redeem his honor after being hired by wealthy Swedish industrialist Henrik Vanger (Christopher Plummer) to solve the 40-year-old murder of Vanger's niece, Harriet. Vanger believes that Harriet was killed by a member of his own family. Eventually joining Blomkvist on his dangerous quest for the truth is Lisbeth Salander (Rooney Mara), an unusual but ingenious investigator whose fragile trust is not easily won.
value.heroDescription: A decades-old case uncovers a disturbing conspiracy in David Fincher’s cyber thriller.

value.title: The Sixth Sense
value.description: Young Cole Sear (Haley Joel Osment) is haunted by a dark secret: he is visited by ghosts. Cole is frightened by visitations from those with unresolved problems who appear from the shadows. He is too afraid to tell anyone about his anguish, except child psychologist Dr. Malcolm Crowe (Bruce Willis). As Dr. Crowe tries to uncover the truth about Cole's supernatural abilities, the consequences for client and therapist are a jolt that awakens them both to something unexplainable.
value.heroDescription: It’s the paranormal thriller with one of the most iconic plot twists in movie history.

value.title: Going the Distance
value.description: Erin's (Drew Barrymore) wry wit and unfiltered frankness charm newly single Garrett (Justin Long) over beer, bar trivia and breakfast the next morning. Their chemistry sparks a full-fledged summer fling, but neither expects it to last once Erin heads home to San Francisco and Garrett stays behind for his job in New York City. But when six weeks of romping through the city inadvertently become meaningful, neither is sure they want it to end. And while Garrett's friends, Box (Jason Sudeikis) and Dan (Charlie Day), joke about his pre-flight calorie-cutting and his full-time relationship with his cell phone, they don't like losing their best drinking buddy to yet another rocky romance. At the same time, Erin's high-strung, overprotective married sister, Corrine (Christina Applegate), wants to keep Erin from heading down an all-too-familiar road. But despite the opposite coasts, the nay-saying friends and family, and a few unexpected temptations, the couple just might go the distance.
value.heroDescription: The romance may be remote but the sparks fly far in this will-they-won’t-they charmer.

value.title: Jurassic World
value.description: Located off the coast of Costa Rica, the Jurassic World luxury resort provides a habitat for an array of genetically engineered dinosaurs, including the vicious and intelligent Indominus rex. When the massive creature escapes, it sets off a chain reaction that causes the other dinos to run amok. Now, it's up to a former military man and animal expert (Chris Pratt) to use his special skills to save two young brothers and the rest of the tourists from an all-out, prehistoric assault.
value.heroDescription: When the theme park finally reopens, a new, bigger threat looms: the Indominus rex.

value.title: American Gangster
value.description: Academy Award winners Denzel Washington and Russell Crowe team with director Ridley Scott (Gladiator) for an epic story as powerful as it is true. Armed with ruthless, street-wise tactics and a strict sense of honor, crime boss Frank Lucas (Washington) rules Harlem's chaotic drug underworld. When outcast cop Richie Roberts (Crowe) sets out to bring down Lucas's multi-million dollar empire, it plunges both men into a legendary confrontation. American Gangster is "a brutal and brilliant film" (Pete Hammond, Maxim)
value.heroDescription: Russell Crowe and Denzel Washington command the screen in this crime saga.

value.title: Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World
value.description: Captain “Lucky” Jack Aubrey (Russell Crowe) is a renowned fighting captain in the British Navy. But when his ship, the Surprise, is suddenly attacked by a superior enemy, Aubrey is torn between duty and friendship as he pursues a high-stakes chase across two oceans to intercept and capture his foe. With a badly damaged ship and an injured crew, this mission can save his reputation, or destroy them all. Nominated for 10 Academy Awards, including Best Picture!

value.title: Fallen
value.description: Academy Award-winner Denzel Washington stars as a tenacious homicide detective caught in the grasp of unimaginable evil in the suspense-thriller Fallen. Detective John Hobbes (Washington) and his partner, Jonesy (John Goodman), apprehend a demonic serial killer and witness his execution--but the grisly murders continue. Do these new slayings point to a copycat killer--or something even more sinister? As the investigation unfolds, Hobbes' superior officer, Lieutenant Stanton (Donald Sutherland), makes a frightening discovery. Now, Detective Hobbes confronts one waking nightmare after another as he battles the evil that dwells within the hearts and souls of the Fallen.
value.heroDescription: This clever chiller pits Denzel Washington’s cop against a body-swapping demon.

value.title: Taxi Driver
value.description: Suffering from insomnia, disturbed loner Travis Bickle (Robert De Niro) takes a job as a New York City cabbie, haunting the streets nightly, growing increasingly detached from reality as he dreams of cleaning up the filthy city. When Travis meets pretty campaign worker Betsy (Cybill Shepherd), he becomes obsessed with the idea of saving the world, first plotting to assassinate a presidential candidate, then directing his attentions toward rescuing 12-year-old prostitute Iris (Jodie Foster).
value.heroDescription: Scorsese’s masterpiece remains smart, provocative, and utterly unique.

value.title: Definitely, Maybe
value.description: When Will (Ryan Reynolds) decides to tell his daughter (Abigail Breslin) the story of how he met her mother, he discovers that a second look at the past might also give him a second chance at the future. Co-starring Elizabeth Banks, Rachel Weisz and Isla Fisher, it's the heartwarming story that makes you realize it's definitely never too late to go back…and maybe find a happy ending.

value.title: A Beautiful Mind
value.description: A human drama inspired by events in the life of John Forbes Nash Jr., and in part based on the biography "A Beautiful Mind" by Sylvia Nasar. From the heights of notoriety to the depths of depravity, John Forbes Nash Jr. experienced it all. A mathematical genius, he made an astonishing discovery early in his career and stood on the brink of international acclaim. But the handsome and arrogant Nash soon found himself on a painful and harrowing journey of self-discovery.
value.heroDescription: Russell Crowe stuns in this Oscar®-winning portrait of genius and mental illness.

value.title: A League of Their Own
value.description: Tom Hanks, Geena Davis and Madonna star in this major-league comedy from the team that brought you Big. Hanks stars as Jimmy Dugan, a washed-up ballplayer whose big league days are over. Hired to coach in the All-American Girls Baseball League of 1943, while the male pros are at war, Dugan finds himself drawn back into the game by the heart and heroics of his all-girl team. Jon Lovitz adds a scene-stealing cameo as the sarcastic scout who recruits Dottie Hinson (Geena Davis), the baseball dolly with a Babe Ruth swing. Teammates Madonna, Lori Petty and Rosie O'Donnell round out the roster, taking the team to the World Series. Based on the true story of the pioneering women who blazed the trail, on the fields and off, for generations of athletes.

value.title: The Rookie
value.description: A high school baseball coach, injured before making it to the big leagues, gets a second chance at a professional pitching career when he agrees to try out for the majors, but only if his perpetually losing team wins the district championship.
value.heroDescription: Get inspired by the true tale of the high school coach who became an MLB player at 35.

items.title: The Boy, the Mole, the Fox and the Horse
Here We Are: Notes for Living on Planet Earth

value.title: A Carpool Karaoke Christmas
value.description: James Corden passes the keys to Zane Lowe for this international holiday road trip. It’s a pop diva winter wonderland when Zane gets festive with Dua Lipa in Japan, Chappell Roan in her Missouri hometown, and Lady Gaga in Los Angeles.
value.heroDescription: Get festive with Lady Gaga, Dua Lipa, and Chappell Roan. Watch the holiday special.

value.title: Messi Mania
value.description: Witness the media craze that followed Messi's transformative move to Inter Miami CF and the ripple effect it sent through the world of soccer.

value.title: MLS Awards Expansion Team to San Diego
value.description: Relive San Diego's epic announcement as Major League Soccer welcomes its thirtieth club.

Peanuts in Space: Secrets of Apollo 10
Here We Are: Notes for Living on Planet Earth
The First Snow of Fraggle Rock

value.title: Shining Girls
value.description: Years after a brutal attack left her in a constantly shifting reality, Kirby Mazrachi learns that a recent murder is linked to her assault. She teams with veteran reporter Dan Velazquez to understand her ever-changing present—and confront her past.
value.heroDescription: An assault survivor investigates a murder linked to her attack.

value.title: All of You
value.description: Laura and Simon have been best friends since college. Over the years, they’ve realized their bond is more than platonic. Can they—and should they—risk everything to explore a love that has existed all along?
value.heroDescription: Everyone thinks they’re just friends. The truth is more complicated.

value.title: BE@RBRICK
value.description: In a town where everyone’s roles are predetermined, an aspiring singer-songwriter and her bandmates break free to pursue their dreams and inspire others to do the same.
value.heroDescription: Bold friends break the rules by secretly starting a pop band.

value.title: Bono: Stories of Surrender
value.description: Through words, music, and mischief, Bono pulls back the curtain on his deeply personal experiences that have shaped him as a son, father, husband, activist, and U2 frontman.
value.heroDescription: U2’s frontman shares personal stories and songs in a creative reimagining of his stage show.

value.title: Boom! Boom! The World vs. Boris Becker
value.description: An inside look at the controversial life and career of tennis great Boris Becker—featuring interviews with John McEnroe, Novak Djokovic, Björn Borg, and other icons.
value.heroDescription: The rise and fall of a tennis legend.

value.title: Born to Be Wild
value.description: From first steps to first hunts, follow six rare baby animals as they learn survival skills and bring hope for the future of their species in the wild.
value.heroDescription: Follow the incredible journey of six rare baby animals as they return to the wild.

value.title: Carpool Karaoke: The Series
value.description: Go on a star-studded, song-filled ride as celebrities share a car, sing along to their personal playlists, and embark on adventures.
value.heroDescription: Hit the road for a star-studded, song-filled ride.

value.title: City on Fire
value.description: A college student is shot in Central Park on July 4, 2003. The investigation connects a series of mysterious citywide fires, the downtown music scene, and a wealthy uptown real estate family fraying under the strain of the many secrets they keep.
value.heroDescription: A Central Park shooting ignites an investigation that unearths dark secrets.

value.title: Doug Unplugs
value.description: Doug is a young robot who senses there’s more to life than just the facts. While other robots plug in for their daily download, Doug unplugs and journeys into the human world with his best friend Emma to experience its wonders firsthand.

value.title: Duck & Goose
value.description: Feathered friends Duck and Goose couldn’t be more different, but in this preschool show, they learn how to bring out the best in one another. Based on books by Tad Hills.
value.heroDescription: A dynamic duo seeks adventure in this playful preschool show.

value.title: Earth at Night in Color
value.description: Narrated by Tom Hiddleston and filmed across six continents, this docuseries uses cutting-edge camera technology to capture animals' nocturnal lives, revealing new behaviors filmed in full color like never before.
value.heroDescription: Cutting-edge cameras reveal the wonders of nature’s nightlife.

value.title: Echo 3
value.description: When brilliant scientist Amber Chesborough vanishes along the Colombia-Venezuela border, her brother and her husband—both elite U.S. Army commandos—struggle to find her amid a guerilla war, discovering that the woman they love might have a secret.
value.heroDescription: Two special ops soldiers embark on a daring rescue mission.

value.title: Eva the Owlet
value.description: Join in on feathery fun as Eva seeks adventure in her treetop community. Each night, she learns lessons, reflects through writing, and lends a helping wing wherever she can. Based on the best-selling book series Owl Diaries.
value.heroDescription: Take flight on fresh adventures with Eva and friends.

value.title: Fraggle Rock: Rock On!
value.description: The Fraggles might be apart in separate caves, but they can still find ways to have fun together! Join Gobo, Red, Boober, Mokey, Wembley, and Uncle Travelling Matt for stories and songs that show everyone how we're all connected.

value.title: Get Rolling With Otis
value.description: Welcome to Long Hill Dairy Farm, home to Otis the tractor and all his friends. Otis may be little, but he has a big heart. Whenever he sees a friend in need, he hits the brakes to see what’s wrong and rolls into action to help.
value.heroDescription: A lovable tractor leads with kindness and compassion.

value.title: Greatness Code
value.description: Iconic athletes pull back the curtain on a pivotal career moment when they touched greatness. A stylized hybrid of live action and visual effects, this short-form docuseries sheds new light on the sports legends you thought you knew.

value.title: Gutsy
value.description: Take an unforgettable journey with Hillary Clinton and Chelsea Clinton as they go on adventures with some of the world’s boldest and bravest women—from household names to unsung heroes—who make us laugh and inspire us to be more gutsy.
value.heroDescription: Take an unforgettable journey with Hillary and Chelsea Clinton. Watch all episodes.

value.title: Hello, Jack! The Kindness Show
value.description: Jack is one of Clover Grove’s most thoughtful and caring residents, greeting everyone with kindness and humor. His ability to spread compassion, creativity, and imagination inspires everyone in town to do the same.
value.heroDescription: New adventures have arrived in Clover Grove.

value.title: Helpsters
value.description: Meet Cody and the Helpsters, a team of vibrant monsters who love to solve problems. Whether it’s planning a party, climbing a mountain, or mastering a magic trick, the Helpsters can figure anything out—because everything starts with a plan.
value.heroDescription: Meet Cody and a crew of monsters who love to solve problems. Watch all episodes.

value.title: Hollywood Con Queen
value.description: A mysterious figure—known as the Con Queen—is impersonating powerful female executives in Hollywood, luring victims with the promise of life-changing career opportunities. A journalist and a private investigator set out to find the culprit behind the scam.
value.heroDescription: Dive into the global hunt for an elusive criminal.

value.title: Imperfect Women
value.description: After a murder shatters the lives of three best friends, their decades-long bond is tested when an investigation reveals betrayals and shocking truths.
value.heroDescription: The secret lives of three best friends turn deadly in this scandalous murder mystery.

value.title: K-Pop Idols
value.description: Glitz meets grit in this backstage pass to artists from around the world. Through trials and triumphs, up-and-coming stars give everything they’ve got to an art form that demands nothing less than perfection.
value.heroDescription: All that glitters isn’t gold for artists chasing stardom.

value.title: KPOPPED
value.description: Global music icons team up with world-renowned K-pop idols for spectacular song battles. Performing their biggest hits with a K-pop twist, these artists show up, show out, and shut it down in a friendly competition for the ultimate bragging rights.
value.heroDescription: Music icons team up with the hottest K-pop groups for song battles with a major twist.

value.title: Land of Women
value.description: Gala (Eva Longoria) is a New York City socialite on the run in a quaint Spanish town with her mother and daughter. Gala’s new life brings her into the path of a brash but charming winery owner—and a deep well of family secrets.
value.heroDescription: Eva Longoria faces family truths and finds love in a Spanish town.

value.title: Liaison
value.description: Two agents—and former lovers—must work together to combat international cyberattacks threatening the UK while also confronting the buried secrets of their destructive relationship.
value.heroDescription: Two agents—and former lovers—unite to fight international cyberterrorists.

value.title: Long Way Home
value.description: Best friends Ewan McGregor and Charley Boorman gear up for their fourth Long Way series—this time going from Ewan’s home in Scotland to Charley’s in England. They’ll take the scenic route, of course, through 17 European countries on cranky old bikes.
value.heroDescription: Two best friends. Two vintage bikes. One epic road trip across 17 European countries.

value.title: Long Way Up
value.description: The epic motorcycle adventure continues in this third chapter of the Long Way series, as Ewan McGregor and Charley Boorman journey to glorious landscapes across South and Central America—on the backs of prototype electric Harley-Davidsons.
value.heroDescription: Ewan McGregor and Charley Boorman charge up for an epic adventure.

value.title: Lulu is a Rhinoceros
value.description: On a quest to spread kindness, fun-loving Lulu embarks on the adventure of a lifetime, powered by new friends, courage, and catchy songs!
value.heroDescription: Join fun-loving Lulu as she embarks on the adventure of a lifetime, fueled by friendship and catchy songs.

value.title: Me
value.description: New school. New family. New superpower. It’s a season of change for 12-year-old Ben Vasani when he discovers that he can transform into anyone he meets. As a shapeshifter, Ben must figure out who he is and who he wants to be.
value.heroDescription: A middle school student discovers his secret superpower. Watch all episodes.

value.title: Midnight Family
value.description: Marigaby is a medical student by day—and by night, she saves lives with her family in Mexico City’s high-stakes business of private ambulances. As pressure from both worlds threatens to drag her down, Marigaby will do whatever it takes to stay afloat.
value.heroDescription: For one family, saving lives means risking theirs.

value.title: My Kind of Country
value.description: Reese Witherspoon and Kacey Musgraves join Jimmie Allen, Mickey Guyton, and Orville Peck on a global search for country music’s next big star in a new kind of competition series.
value.heroDescription: Artists search the world for rising talent in a music competition series.

value.title: Napoleon: The Director’s Cut
value.description: Witness this epic in its full glory with 48 minutes of new footage. A personal look at the French military leader’s origins and swift, ruthless climb to emperor, it's viewed through the prism of Napoleon’s volatile relationship with his wife, Josephine.
value.heroDescription: Experience Ridley Scott’s extended epic, including 48 more minutes of thrilling footage.

value.title: Now and Then
value.description: On the eve of college graduation, six best friends embark on an epic weekend to celebrate—but it takes a fatal turn. Nearly 20 years later, the survivors are reluctantly reunited by a blackmail text threatening to expose the truth about that fateful night.
value.heroDescription: Untangle a web of lies as five friends confront a dark secret.

value.title: Number One on the Call Sheet
value.description: Some of Hollywood’s biggest stars reveal their journeys to game-changing leading roles. In candid interviews, they shine a light on the highs and lows of their craft, breakthrough moments, blueprints for success, and the next generation’s huge potential.
value.heroDescription: Some of Hollywood’s biggest stars get candid about their journeys to game-changing leading roles.

value.title: Omnivore
value.description: From Peruvian salt flats to Rwandan coffee forests, explore and celebrate the ingredients that built societies, shaped beliefs, and forever altered the tapestry of humanity. Narrated by world-renowned chef René Redzepi.
value.heroDescription: Food is never just food in this culinary escapade.

value.title: Oprah Talks COVID-19
value.description: How can we mindfully move through a crisis while holding on to ourselves and our humanity? In this series, Oprah has remote conversations with experts and everyday people to provide insight, meaning, and tangible advice for the human spirit.

value.title: Pinecone & Pony
value.description: Kate Beaton’s beloved book comes to life in this animated series. As a warrior in training, Pinecone fears no challenge. Thankfully, Pony always makes sure Pinecone never gets in over her head. Together they learn life can be a fun-filled adventure.
value.heroDescription: Sturdystone’s fearless duo face life’s adventures together.

value.title: Pretzel and the Puppies
value.description: Meet Pretzel, the world’s longest dachshund and a playful, supportive dad to five frisky puppies. Together with his wife, Greta, they encourage their pups to get their paws up to solve problems and “make their bark” on the world.
value.heroDescription: Playful dachshunds solve problems together.

value.title: Prime Target
value.description: A brilliant Cambridge math student (Leo Woodall) is on the verge of a major breakthrough when a shadowy enemy tries to stop him. Fighting for answers—and his life—he teams up with a government agent to unravel a high-stakes conspiracy.
value.heroDescription: Leo Woodall stars as a math genius entangled in a deadly scheme.

value.title: Puppy Place
value.description: Charles and Lizzie Peterson have found the perfect way to foster their love of dogs—literally. The siblings take on the tough but rewarding task of fostering puppies and finding their forever homes. With every new pup, a new adventure begins.

value.title: Real Madrid: Until The End
value.description: Step onto the field and go behind the scenes with the iconic soccer team for a look at their astonishing 2021–2022 season. Fueled by their fervent fans, they defy the odds and silence the skeptics.
value.heroDescription: Go behind the scenes of the club’s historic 2021–2022 season.

value.title: Sago Mini Friends
value.description: Welcome to Sagoville, where Harvey loves to play and discover ways to have silly fun! He and his closest friends explore, imagine, and express true thankfulness for all things, big and small, through creative adventures and unforgettable songs.
value.heroDescription: Celebrate gratitude with a colorful crew of preschool pals. Watch all episodes.

value.title: Slumberkins
value.description: Embark on adventures with Bigfoot, Unicorn, Sloth, Yak, and Fox as they explore a world of feelings in this Jim Henson Company series that brings the emotional learning of Slumberkins to life.
value.heroDescription: Snuggly friends learn about a world of feelings.

value.title: It's the Small Things, Charlie Brown
value.description: Charlie Brown is determined to win the big baseball game. But things turn into a fiasco right before the matchup, when Sally bonds with a little flower on the pitcher’s mound and vows to protect it at all costs.
value.heroDescription: Sally’s love for a little flower becomes a big problem for Charlie Brown.

value.title: Welcome Home, Franklin
value.description: Franklin is new to town and hoping to make friends, but his usual tactics don’t work on the Peanuts gang. When the Soap Box Derby arrives, he’s sure it’s a chance to impress new pals and teams up with the only other unpartnered kid: Charlie Brown.

value.title: STEVE! (martin) a documentary in 2 pieces
value.description: Steve Martin is one of the most beloved and enigmatic figures in entertainment. Dive into his extraordinary story from two distinct points of view—past and present—as Martin reflects on how his beginnings led to his unexpectedly fulfilling life today.
value.heroDescription: Dive into the icon’s story from two points of view: then and now.

value.title: Still Up
value.description: Bonded by insomnia, best friends Lisa and Danny stay connected to each other late into the night and find their way through a world of wonderfully weird surprises as their relationship deepens.
value.heroDescription: Two insomniacs grow closer through late-night adventures.

value.title: Strange Planet
value.description: Welcome to a distant planet not unlike our own, with hilarious yet poignant observations on life, love, and friendship—told in the most peculiar way. From creators Nathan W. Pyle and Dan Harmon.
value.heroDescription: A comical look at a world not unlike ours.

value.title: Surfside Girls
value.description: Quick wits lead to daring discoveries for beachside besties Sam and Jade as they sleuth out supernatural mysteries in their sleepy hometown of Surfside. Based on the best-selling young adult graphic novels.
value.heroDescription: Dive into a world of magic and mystery.

value.title: Swagger
value.description: From NBA star Kevin Durant, filmmaker Reggie Rock Bythewood, and the team behind Friday Night Lights. A basketball prodigy must navigate a maze of pressure if he’s going to overcome the odds against him and learn what it truly means to have swagger.
value.heroDescription: Greatness is a journey in this coming-of-age show from Kevin Durant.

value.title: The Big Door Prize
value.description: A small town is forever changed when a mysterious machine appears, promising to reveal everyone’s true potential. Soon residents start changing jobs, rethinking relationships, and questioning long-held beliefs—all in pursuit of a better future.
value.heroDescription: A small town is forever changed by a mysterious machine.

value.title: The Changeling
value.description: Apollo and Emma’s love story is a fairy tale—until Emma mysteriously vanishes. Bereft, Apollo finds himself on a death-defying odyssey through a New York City he didn’t know existed. Based on the award-winning novel.
value.heroDescription: LaKeith Stanfield stars in a dark fairy tale.

value.title: The Hunt
value.description: When friends on a hunting trip get into a deadly clash with other hunters, they vow to keep it a secret. But as paranoia sets in—and a ruthless gang seeks revenge—the friends must confront their morality, families, and savage instincts.
value.heroDescription: A group of friends go from hunting to being hunted after a clash in the mountains turns deadly.

value.title: The Line
value.description: In covert modern warfare, the line between right and wrong has blurred. This docuseries examines the moral ambiguities of war as embodied by the 2018 case in which a U.S. Navy SEAL platoon accused its chief, Eddie Gallagher, of war crimes.
value.heroDescription: Dive into the biggest war crimes trial in a generation.

value.title: The Oprah Conversation
value.description: Oprah leads intimate discussions with today’s foremost newsmakers, thought leaders, and masters of their craft. Bringing truth and perspective to a range of topics shaping our world, they reveal gripping stories of human connection.

value.title: The Problem With Jon Stewart
value.description: Wielding his signature humor, Jon Stewart walks through America’s most persistent problems to find solutions with people at the highest levels of power...if they’d only return his calls.
value.heroDescription: Jon looks for solutions to America’s persistent problems.

value.title: The Shrink Next Door
value.description: Inspired by the true story of Marty and the therapist who turned his life around...then took it over. When he first meets Dr. Ike, Marty just wants to get better at boundaries. Over 30 years, he'll learn all about them—and what happens when they get crossed.
value.heroDescription: A therapist turns his client’s life around...and then takes it over.

value.title: The Wanted Man
value.description: For 20 years, Felix Carmichael has been the untouchable leader of Britain's most feared criminal empire. But when a betrayal within his ranks leads to incarceration, Felix will risk everything to exact revenge and reclaim his throne.

value.title: The Wild Ones
value.description: Explore hidden corners of Earth with a trio of experts as they try to save six endangered species from extinction. With crafty camerawork and survival skills, the team race to find, record, and protect these elusive creatures before it’s too late.
value.heroDescription: Join a breathtaking race across the globe to save six endangered species.

value.title: They Call Me Magic
value.description: Earvin “Magic” Johnson is an icon for the ages—from humble beginnings to the Dream Team to business titan. Featuring interviews with President Obama, Larry Bird, Pat Riley, and more, this docuseries charts the life and career of a legend.
value.heroDescription: Get to know the life and legacy of global icon Earvin “Magic” Johnson.

value.title: To Mom (and Dad), With Love
value.description: Mother’s Day is almost here, and the gang is excited—except Peppermint Patty. For her, it’s a reminder that she didn’t grow up with a mom. But good pal Marcie helps Peppermint Patty see that families come in all shapes and sizes.
value.heroDescription: As Mother’s Day draws near, the Peanuts gang celebrates families of all kinds.

value.title: 'Twas The Fight Before Christmas
value.description: In this true-life twist on a holiday fable, Jeremy Morris brings a whole new meaning to Christmas spirit when his extravagant seasonal display sparks a dispute with his neighbors that lands them all in court.
value.heroDescription: A seasonal display ignites a not-so-merry legal battle.

value.title: Vietnam: The War That Changed America
value.description: The reunion of old friends, first-person accounts, and rarely seen footage paint an extraordinary and deeply profound picture of what it was like to live through one of history’s longest wars. Narrated by Ethan Hawke.
value.heroDescription: Ethan Hawke narrates this powerful look at the personal impact of the war.

value.title: Visible: Out on Television
value.description: Explore the history of the American LGBTQ movement through the lens of TV in this five-part docuseries. Combining archival footage with new interviews, the series looks at homophobia, the evolution of LGBTQ characters, and coming out in the TV world.
value.heroDescription: Explore the history of the LGBTQ movement through the lens of TV.

value.title: Wanted: The Escape of Carlos Ghosn
value.description: The riveting story of CEO-turned-fugitive Carlos Ghosn, including his reign of power, shocking arrest, and calculated getaway that stunned the world.
value.heroDescription: The shocking story of a CEO turned fugitive.

value.title: Watch the Sound With Mark Ronson
value.description: Oscar®- and GRAMMY Award®–winning producer and artist Mark Ronson explores the intersection of technology and musical innovation with his heroes and fellow hitmakers—including Paul McCartney, DJ Premier, Charli XCX, Dave Grohl, and Questlove.
value.heroDescription: Legends and hitmakers go deep on the evolution of musical innovations.

value.title: Women in Blue
value.description: In 1970s Mexico, four women defy ultraconservative norms and join the first female police force—only to discover it’s a publicity stunt to distract from a serial killer. As the body count grows, they vow to bring the killer to justice. Inspired by true events.
value.heroDescription: Four women risk it all to hunt a serial killer in 1970s Mexico. Inspired by true events.

value.title: Wonder Pets: In the City
value.description: Team up for heroic adventures with Izzy the Guinea Pig, Zuri the Bunny, and Tate the Snake—a trio of opera-singing New York City classroom pets—as they answer calls from animals in need all around the world.
value.heroDescription: Join these opera-singing classroom pets on musical adventures to help animals all around the world.

value.title: Yo Gabba GabbaLand!
value.description: Step inside a fantastic land of fun and imagination with Kammy Kam and her beloved friends! Through music and magic, they learn about their world and unlock limitless wonder.
value.heroDescription: Dance and learn along with Kammy Kam and friends as they explore the wonderful world around them.

value.title: You Would Do It Too
value.description: A bus is hijacked by three robbers—who end up dead before they can get away. Every passenger’s story is the same: a hooded man saved the day. As the case unfolds, the line between hero and criminal begins to blur.
value.heroDescription: A mystery man becomes a wanted criminal and a hero overnight.

value.title: The Savant
value.description: Jessica Chastain stars as a top-secret undercover investigator known as the Savant, who infiltrates online hate groups to take down the most violent extremists in the United States.
value.heroDescription: A top-secret investigator risks everything to infiltrate and take down violent extremists.

value.title: Prodigies
value.description: Didi and Ren have been together since they were nine-year-old geniuses. Now in their early thirties and engaged to be married, they begin to wonder if they’ve settled for a life—and love—that’s less than extraordinary.

value.title: Bad Monkey
value.description: A detective turned restaurant inspector in Southern Florida is pulled into a world of greed and corruption. And yes, there's a monkey.
value.heroDescription: Vince Vaughn finds trouble on the shady side of paradise.

value.title: Stick
value.description: Pryce Cahill (Owen Wilson) was headed for golf greatness when an on-course meltdown derailed his career. Now struggling to stay afloat, he goes all in to mentor Santi—a teenage phenom with immense potential—and maybe save himself.
value.heroDescription: Owen Wilson is back and taking a big, risky swing at reviving his glory days just as his protégé reaches new heights.

value.title: There’s No Place Like Home, Snoopy
value.description: When Snoopy’s beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.
value.heroDescription: Follow Snoopy as he searches for his prized possession—and discovers what matters most.

value.title: Lucky
value.description: When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky (Anya Taylor-Joy) is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life—and a way out.
value.heroDescription: A con artist must run for her life and confront her past when a multimillion-dollar heist goes sideways.

value.title: Star City
value.description: Step into a thrilling chapter inspired by For All Mankind. Same alt-history universe. Different perspective: the Soviet Union’s. Go behind the Iron Curtain with the cosmonauts, engineers, and intelligence officers who risked it all in the race for the Moon.
value.heroDescription: A thrilling chapter inspired by For All Mankind, where the stakes are deadlier on the ground than in space.

value.title: Propeller One-Way Night Coach
value.description: During the golden age of aviation, a young airplane enthusiast and his mother embark on a cross-country journey to Hollywood—and their simple flight transforms into the trip of a lifetime. A film by John Travolta.
value.heroDescription: John Travolta’s directorial debut tells the magical story of a young boy and his mother taking the trip of a lifetime.

value.title: Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed
value.description: A newly divorced mom falls down a dangerous rabbit hole of blackmail, murder, and youth soccer.
value.heroDescription: A soccer mom falls down a rabbit hole of blackmail and murder.

value.title: Unconditional
value.description: A mother-daughter vacation abroad takes a devastating turn when Gali is arrested for drug possession. Refusing to accept the charges, her mother Orna risks everything on a quest for freedom—only to get entangled in a web of Gali’s secrets.
value.heroDescription: A mother will stop at nothing to rescue her daughter from a foreign prison—and a deadly criminal underworld.

value.title: My Brother the Minotaur
value.description: When a minotaur raised by humans starts dreaming of his mythical past, he sets out on a wild adventure—with help from his brother and friends—to understand who he really is.
value.heroDescription: After years living in the human world, a young minotaur sets out to discover who he really is.

value.title: Criminal Record
value.description: London detectives Hegarty and Lenker both believe in fighting crime—but have very different ideas about the right way to do it. Forced into a partnership neither of them asked for, they must work together to serve justice in a rapidly changing world.
value.heroDescription: Forced to work together, two detectives clash as they pursue London’s most wanted.

value.title: Margo’s Got Money Troubles
value.description: The daughter of a former Hooters waitress and an ex-pro wrestler, Margo is a recent college dropout and aspiring writer. Faced with a new baby, mounting pile of bills, and dwindling number of ways to pay them, Margo must find a way forward.
value.heroDescription: Elle Fanning, Michelle Pfeiffer, Nick Offerman, and Nicole Kidman star in a story of family, dysfunction, and wrestling.

value.title: Twisted Yoga
value.description: Ex-members of a tantric yoga school speak out about how they went from searching for wellness and community to fearing they’d joined a cult, and seeking justice for alleged abuse and manipulation at the hands of a self-styled guru.
value.heroDescription: Ex-members recount their harrowing experiences in a cult led by a self-styled guru amid an ongoing investigation.

value.title: Drops of God
value.description: While the world of wine mourns the death of Alexandre Léger, his estranged daughter, Camille, learns his extraordinary collection is now hers. But before she can claim her inheritance, Camille must best Alexandre’s protégé, Issei, in a test of their senses.
value.heroDescription: It’s winner-takes-all when two wine geniuses battle for a life-changing inheritance.

value.title: Tehran
value.description: Tamar is a Mossad hacker-agent who infiltrates Tehran under a false identity to help destroy Iran’s nuclear reactor. But when her mission fails, Tamar must plan an operation that will place everyone dear to her in jeopardy.
value.heroDescription: A secret agent embarks on her most dangerous mission yet.

value.title: F1 The Movie
value.description: Racing legend Sonny Hayes is coaxed into leading a struggling Formula 1 team—and mentoring a young hotshot driver—while chasing one last chance at redemption.
value.heroDescription: A racing legend returns to the track—and clashes with a rising hotshot—in this epic thrill ride.

value.title: The First Snow of Fraggle Rock
value.description: When the holidays are filled with unexpected adventures and challenges, the Fraggles learn to appreciate each day for being unique and special, like a snowflake.
value.heroDescription: The Fraggles go looking for holiday spirit when snow is a no-show.

value.title: Palm Royale
value.description: In 1969, an ambitious woman aspires to cross the line between the haves and have-nots to secure her seat at America’s most exclusive, fashionable, and treacherous table: Palm Beach high society.
value.heroDescription: Kristen Wiig continues her quest to rule Palm Beach society by any schemes necessary.

value.title: Down Cemetery Road
value.description: From the executive producers of Slow Horses. When a house mysteriously explodes in the British suburbs, a concerned neighbor teams up with a private investigator to find the truth—landing them in the middle of a chilling government conspiracy.
value.heroDescription: From the executive producers of Slow Horses. A deadly explosion in the suburbs blows the lid off a chilling government secret.

value.title: Stiller & Meara: Nothing Is Lost
value.description: Ben Stiller tells the story of his parents—comedy icons Jerry Stiller and Anne Meara—exploring their impact on popular culture and at home, where the lines between creativity, family, life, and art often blurred.
value.heroDescription: Ben Stiller gets personal as he tells the story of his parents, comedy icons Jerry Stiller and Anne Meara.

value.title: The Last Frontier
value.description: When a prison transport plane suspiciously crashes near a rugged Alaskan town, the region’s U.S. marshal ignites a manhunt for dozens of violent inmates—and the criminal mastermind he believes is behind it all.
value.heroDescription: A suspicious plane crash ignites a manhunt for escaped prisoners, and the mastermind behind it all.

value.title: The Lost Bus
value.description: A determined father (Matthew McConaughey) risks everything to rescue a dedicated teacher (America Ferrera) and her students from a raging wildfire. Inspired by a true story of survival.
value.heroDescription: To save 22 children, they risk everything—including their lives. Inspired by a true story of survival.

value.title: The Morning Show
value.description: Pull back the curtain on early morning TV. Starring Reese Witherspoon and Jennifer Aniston, this unapologetically candid drama looks at the modern workplace through the lens of the people who help America wake up.
value.heroDescription: Scandals, affairs, conspiracies. And that’s just the news team.

value.title: Highest 2 Lowest
value.description: When a powerful music mogul (Denzel Washington) is targeted by a ransom plot, he is forced to fight for his family and legacy while jammed up in a life-or-death moral dilemma.
value.heroDescription: Family, legacy, and a fortune are on the line in this gripping Spike Lee Joint starring Denzel Washington.

value.title: Shape Island
value.description: On a charming island, Square, Triangle, and Circle seek adventure and connection while learning how to navigate each other’s differences. Based on the internationally best-selling books by Mac Barnett and Jon Klassen.
value.heroDescription: Three friends dream, create, and explore the wonders of the wilderness.

value.title: A Summer Musical
value.description: Music and glee fill the air as Charlie Brown and the gang head off to summer camp. First-timer Sally doesn’t get what all the hype is about. But when the camp may be forced to close, they team up to save it so more kids can make their own special memories.
value.heroDescription: Music and joy fill the air as Snoopy and the gang head to summer camp.

value.title: Chief of War
value.description: Embark on an epic adventure about the origin of Hawai‘i and its people. Jason Momoa stars as Kaʻiana, a fearless warrior on a mission to unite his homeland as a monumental power struggle erupts among the four kingdoms.
value.heroDescription: An epic adventure about the origin of Hawai‘i, its people, and a dangerous fight for power.

value.title: Smoke
value.description: When an arson investigator begrudgingly teams up with a police detective, their race to stop two arsonists ignites a twisted game of secrets and suspicions.
value.heroDescription: A search for serial arsonists ignites a twisted game of secrets and suspicions.

value.title: The Buccaneers
value.description: A group of fun-loving American girls burst onto the scene in tightly corseted 1870s London, kicking off an Anglo-American culture clash. Sent to secure husbands and status, the buccaneers’ hearts are set on much more than that.
value.heroDescription: Desire. Secrets. Betrayal. Love is a dangerous game.

value.title: Echo Valley
value.description: Julianne Moore is Kate, whose secluded life is interrupted by her troubled daughter (Sydney Sweeney) when she shows up frightened and covered in someone's blood. As Kate unravels the shocking truth, she learns how far she’ll go for her child.
value.heroDescription: A mother at peace. A daughter in crisis. A night that changes everything.

value.title: Fountain of Youth
value.description: A treasure-hunting mastermind (John Krasinski) assembles a team for a life-changing adventure. But to outwit and outrun threats at every turn, he’ll need someone even smarter than he is: his estranged sister (Natalie Portman).
value.heroDescription: It’s only a legend until you discover it. Let the treasure hunt begin.

value.title: Deaf President Now!
value.description: Discover the story of the greatest civil rights movement most people have never heard about. During eight tumultuous days in 1988 at the world’s only Deaf university, four students must find a way to lead a revolution—and change the course of history.
value.heroDescription: At the world’s only Deaf university, a revolution refused to be silenced.

value.title: Carême
value.description: Witness the rise of the world’s first celebrity chef, Antonin Carême, and his descent into espionage in Napoleon-era France—where manipulation is king. With his gifts for gastronomy and seduction, he becomes the perfect weapon in a fight for power.
value.heroDescription: A seductive culinary genius becomes a spy in Napoleon-era France, where manipulation is king.

value.title: Jane
value.description: Budding environmentalist Jane is a 9-year-old on a quest to save endangered animals. Using her powerful imagination, Jane takes her best friends David and Greybeard the chimpanzee on epic adventures to help protect wild animals all around the world.
value.heroDescription: Gear up for exciting adventures to help endangered animals around the world.

value.title: Government Cheese
value.description: When Hampton (David Oyelowo) is released from prison, his long-awaited family reunion doesn’t quite go as he hoped. In his absence, Hampton’s wife and sons formed an unconventional family unit, and his return spins their world into chaos.
value.heroDescription: An ex-con aims to turn a new leaf—and make history.

value.title: Fight for Glory: 2024 World Series
value.description: Experience the battle of juggernauts like never before as the Yankees and Dodgers revive MLB’s most iconic playoff rivalry. With intimate access to superstar players, managers, and their families, witness the sacrifices it takes to claim baseball’s throne.
value.heroDescription: Experience the Fall Classic like never before as the Yankees and Dodgers clash in a battle of Goliaths.

value.title: Side Quest
value.description: Go deeper into the Mythic Quest universe in these four standalone stories. Follow the lives of players, comic book shop owners, touring orchestra musicians, and members of the art department as they search for community, success, and love.
value.heroDescription: Dive deeper into the Mythic Quest universe in a hilarious spinoff.

value.title: Dope Thief
value.description: Two lifelong friends (Brian Tyree Henry and Wagner Moura) in Philadelphia pose as DEA agents to rob small-time drug dealers. It’s a perfect grift—until they choose the wrong mark and become targets of a massive narcotics enterprise.
value.heroDescription: Two lifelong friends are on the run for their lives after stealing from a major drug kingpin.

value.title: Berlin ER
value.description: After her private life falls apart, a young doctor seeking a fresh start takes over the emergency room in Berlin’s toughest, most chaotic hospital. Battling staff resistance and a run-down system, she must unite her maverick team to save lives.
value.heroDescription: A young doctor takes over a chaotic emergency room.

value.title: Surface
value.description: A traumatic head injury leaves Sophie with extreme memory loss. In her quest to put the pieces of her life back together—with help from her husband and friends—Sophie begins to question the truth behind her picture-perfect life.
value.heroDescription: A dark secret ignites a quest for the truth—and revenge.

value.title: Onside: Major League Soccer
value.description: Go beyond the pitch with unparalleled access to the players and personalities who power MLS. Electrifying moments and captivating stories made 2024 an unforgettable season—and gave us a glimpse of the future.
value.heroDescription: Get unprecedented access to the players who powered the 2024 season.

value.title: Goldie
value.description: Follow Goldie as she shakes up her beloved town of Boysenberg with her best friends. Together, they learn that being different is something to celebrate—and it’s a whole lot of fun.
value.heroDescription: A young giant shakes up her tiny town with her best friends.

value.title: Love You To Death
value.description: Raúl’s world is unraveling. Marta’s unexpectedly pregnant. After a funeral meet-cute brings them together, they stumble through the chaos of life and love.
value.heroDescription: A funeral meet-cute sparks a one-of-a-kind romance.

value.title: Mythic Quest
value.description: Meet the team behind the biggest multiplayer video game of all time. But in a workplace focused on building worlds, molding heroes, and creating legends, the most hard-fought battles don’t occur in the game—they happen in the office.
value.heroDescription: Rob McElhenney and his chaotic team return in this hilarious hit.

value.title: Bread & Roses
value.description: In the wake of the Taliban’s return to power, a group of Kabul women lead a revolutionary fight for their rights—and their lives. From producers Malala Yousafzai and Jennifer Lawrence.
value.heroDescription: A group of Kabul women leads a revolutionary fight for their rights.

value.title: Blitz
value.description: In World War II London, nine-year-old George is evacuated to the countryside by his mother, Rita, to escape the bombings. Defiant and determined to return to his family, George embarks on an epic, perilous journey back home as Rita searches for him.
value.heroDescription: A mother will do anything to protect her son in WWII London.

value.title: Before
value.description: After tragically losing his wife, child psychiatrist Dr. Eli Adler (Billy Crystal) encounters a troubled young boy who seems to have a haunting connection to Eli’s past.
value.heroDescription: Billy Crystal stars in a chilling psychological mystery.

value.title: Disclaimer
value.description: A mysterious delivery threatens to expose a celebrated journalist’s past. Cate Blanchett and Kevin Kline star in a series written for the screen and directed by Alfonso Cuarón.
value.heroDescription: Cate Blanchett is a celebrated journalist whose life and family are threatened by a mysterious delivery.

value.title: The Last of the Sea Women
value.description: On the shores of Jeju Island, a fierce group of South Korean divers fight to save their vanishing culture from looming threats.
value.heroDescription: Extraordinary divers defend their legacy from looming threats.

value.title: Wolfs
value.description: Two rival fixers (George Clooney and Brad Pitt) cross paths when they’re both called in to help cover up a prominent New York official’s misstep. Over one explosive night, they’ll have to set aside their petty grievances—and their egos—to finish the job.
value.heroDescription: George Clooney and Brad Pitt are rival fixers—heavy on the rival.

value.title: La Maison
value.description: High fashion meets high drama in this behind-the-curtain look at an iconic French haute couture house. When the family dynasty behind the house falls into scandal, they must find a way to reinvent themselves—or be destroyed by their rivals.
value.heroDescription: Rocked by scandal, a fashion house designs its comeback.

value.title: Pachinko
value.description: Based on the New York Times bestseller, this sweeping saga chronicles the hopes and dreams of a Korean immigrant family across four generations as they leave their homeland in an indomitable quest to survive and thrive.
value.heroDescription: Take a powerful journey with four generations of a Korean immigrant family.

value.title: The Instigators
value.description: Rory and Cobby are unlikely partners: a desperate father and an ex-con thrown together for a heist. When it goes awry, they team up with an unusual accomplice—Rory’s therapist—to outrun police, backward bureaucrats, and a vengeful crime boss.
value.heroDescription: Boston’s most wanted. And least qualified.

value.title: Cowboy Cartel
value.description: When a rookie FBI agent uncovers a massive money laundering operation in American horse racing, he risks his life to take down the culprits: Mexico’s deadliest cartel.
value.heroDescription: There’s a deadly crime ring in the winner’s circle.

value.title: Time Bandits
value.description: Eleven-year-old Kevin’s passion for history is put to the test when he joins a ragtag group of time-traveling thieves on a high-stakes and hilarious adventure in this epic reimagining of the iconic film.
value.heroDescription: Lisa Kudrow leads a thrilling trip through time and space.

value.title: Lady in the Lake
value.description: When the disappearance of a young girl grips the city of Baltimore in 1966, the lives of two women converge on a fatal collision course.
value.heroDescription: The lives of two women converge in a ’60s murder mystery.

value.title: Sunny
value.description: The life of an American woman living in Kyoto, Japan, is upended when her husband and son disappear in a mysterious plane crash. As consolation, she’s given Sunny, one of a new class of domestic robots made by her husband’s electronics company.
value.heroDescription: Rashida Jones searches for answers about her missing family.

value.title: The Big Cigar
value.description: Black Panther Party co-founder Huey P. Newton enlists an unlikely ally—Hollywood producer Bert Schneider—to elude an FBI manhunt and escape to Cuba.
value.heroDescription: A Black Panther co-founder enlists the help of a Hollywood producer.

value.title: Argylle
value.description: When the plots of her books get too close to the activities of a sinister underground syndicate, introverted spy novelist Elly Conway and her cat are plunged into the real world of espionage—where nothing, and no one, is what it seems.
value.heroDescription: This espionage thriller follows the globetrotting adventures of a superspy.

value.title: Franklin
value.description: In December 1776, Benjamin Franklin is world-famous for his electrical experiments. But his passion and power are put to the test when he embarks on a secret mission to France—with the fate of American independence hanging in the balance.
value.heroDescription: An American founding father sets out on a secret mission.

value.title: Girls State
value.description: What would American democracy look like in the hands of teenage girls? In this documentary, young female leaders from wildly different backgrounds in Missouri navigate an immersive experiment to build a government from the ground up.
value.heroDescription: Teen girls build a democratic government from the ground up.

value.title: The Bloody Hundredth
value.description: Meet the real-life airmen who inspired Masters of the Air as they share the harrowing and transformative events of the 100th Bomb Group. Narrated by Tom Hanks and featuring Steven Spielberg.
value.heroDescription: Meet the real-life airmen who inspired Masters of the Air.

value.title: Napoleon
value.description: A personal look at the French military leader’s origins and swift, ruthless climb to emperor. The story is viewed through the prism of Napoleon’s addictive, volatile relationship with his wife and one true love, Josephine.
value.heroDescription: Joaquin Phoenix is the French military leader in this explosive historical epic from Ridley Scott.

value.title: The Completely Made-Up Adventures of Dick Turpin
value.description: Legendary highwayman Dick Turpin sets out on a series of wildly absurd escapades when he’s made the reluctant leader of a band of outlaws—and tasked with outwitting utterly corrupt lawman Jonathan Wilde.
value.heroDescription: An unlikely criminal embarks on thrillingly absurd escapades.

value.title: Constellation
value.description: When a fatal accident occurs on board the International Space Station, a lone astronaut makes the heroic journey back to Earth, only to discover key pieces of her life—including her young daughter—have changed.
value.heroDescription: A mysterious accident in space unravels an astronaut’s life back home.

value.title: Messi’s World Cup: The Rise of a Legend
value.description: Follow the legend’s epic journey through five World Cups, culminating in 2022’s triumph. As the championship run unfolds, Messi shares some of his most personal reflections—on his national team career and the challenges he’s faced.
value.heroDescription: Join the icon’s journey through five World Cups to lead Argentina to a title.

value.title: The Dynasty: New England Patriots
value.description: Go inside the franchise’s 20-year journey, from the unique chemistry that fueled six Super Bowl wins to the internal strife that sparked a turf war. Tom Brady, Bill Belichick, Robert Kraft, and key players reveal the road to—and cost of—greatness.
value.heroDescription: Brady, Belichick, and Kraft finally tell the true story of their reign.

value.title: The New Look
value.description: This thrilling series reveals the shocking story of how fashion icon Christian Dior and his contemporaries including Coco Chanel, Pierre Balmain, and Cristóbal Balenciaga navigated the horrors of World War Il and launched modern fashion.
value.heroDescription: In World War II Paris, fashion legends fight for their lives—and legacies.

value.title: Killers of the Flower Moon
value.description: When oil is discovered in 1920s Oklahoma under Osage Nation land, the Osage people are murdered one by one—until the FBI steps in to unravel the mystery.
value.heroDescription: Leonardo DiCaprio, Robert De Niro, and Lily Gladstone star in a Martin Scorsese film.

value.title: John Lennon: Murder Without A Trial
value.description: For the first time, key figures from John Lennon’s life and death—including friends, doctors, and investigators—share personal memories and reveal what happened on the night of his killing.
value.heroDescription: Witnesses, friends, and officials finally open up about the icon’s death.

value.title: The Enfield Poltergeist
value.description: Experience the chilling true story of the world’s most famous poltergeist case through original audio recordings made inside the house as the events unfolded.
value.heroDescription: Encounter the famous haunting—through actual audio.

value.title: Lessons in Chemistry
value.description: In the 1950s, Elizabeth Zott’s dream of being a scientist is challenged by a society that says women belong in the domestic sphere. She accepts a job on a TV cooking show and sets out to teach a nation of overlooked housewives way more than recipes.
value.heroDescription: A brilliant scientist becomes a TV cooking show host.

value.title: Messi Meets America
value.description: Join Lionel Messi as he embarks on his historic next chapter—taking North America and Major League Soccer by storm, and ushering in a new era of the game with his Inter Miami CF teammates.
value.heroDescription: Follow the legend as he joins Inter Miami CF and takes MLS by storm.

value.title: Flora and Son
value.description: Single mom Flora is at a loss about what to do with her rebellious teenage son, Max. Her efforts to keep him out of trouble lead to a beat-up acoustic guitar, a washed-up LA musician, and harmony for this frayed Dublin family.
value.heroDescription: Eve Hewson is a Dublin mom trying to reach her troubled son with music.

value.title: Interrupting Chicken
value.description: Little red chicken Piper is a budding writer who uses her big imagination to rewrite stories, jumping into the action to create unforgettable adventures. Based on David Ezra Stein’s best-selling, award-winning children’s book series.
value.heroDescription: Piper and friends put new twists on classic stories. Watch all episodes.

value.title: The Super Models
value.description: In the ‘80s, Naomi Campbell, Cindy Crawford, Linda Evangelista, and Christy Turlington became fashion icons—then transcended their industry by uniting. This is the story of how they claimed their power and shaped the world that followed.
value.heroDescription: Naomi, Cindy, Linda, and Christy tell their own stories.

value.title: Physical
value.description: Sheila Rubin is a quietly tormented housewife in ’80s San Diego. Behind closed doors, she battles extreme personal demons and a vicious inner voice. But things change when she discovers aerobics, sparking a journey toward empowerment and success.
value.heroDescription: A troubled ’80s housewife is transformed after discovering aerobics.

value.title: The Beanie Bubble
value.description: Ty was a frustrated toy salesman until his collaboration with three women turned his stuffed animals into a defining ’90s trend. This behind-the-scenes look at history’s biggest toy craze is a wild story about what—and who—is valued in this world.
value.heroDescription: Take a behind-the-scenes look at history’s biggest toy craze.

value.title: Stephen Curry: Underrated
value.description: The remarkable coming-of-age story of Stephen Curry—one of the most influential, dynamic, and unexpected players in basketball history—and his rise from an undersized college player to a four-time NBA champion.
value.heroDescription: The coming-of-age story of a basketball icon.

value.title: The Afterparty
value.description: Nothing is as it seems in this hilarious murder mystery where each suspect’s story is told through a different genre.
value.heroDescription: Someone would kill for an invite to this hilarious all-star whodunit.

value.title: The Crowded Room
value.description: A psychological thriller set in Manhattan in the summer of 1979, when a young man is arrested for a shocking crime—and an unlikely investigator must solve the mystery behind it.
value.heroDescription: Tom Holland and Amanda Seyfried shine in a ’70s psychological mystery.

value.title: High Desert
value.description: Peggy Newman, a woman with a checkered past, makes the life-changing decision to become a private investigator following the death of her beloved mother, who she lived with in the small desert town of Yucca Valley, California.
value.heroDescription: An eccentric woman with a wild past becomes a private investigator in this offbeat caper.

value.title: Harriet the Spy
value.description: Outspoken and perpetually curious. That’s 11-year-old Harriet in a nutshell. But if she’s going to be Harriet M. Welsch, future writer, she’ll need to know everything. And to know everything means she’ll need to spy…on everyone.
value.heroDescription: Crack open the composition books for some snooping and scooping.

value.title: Big Beasts
value.description: Travel from freezing poles to tropical rainforests to meet nature’s most captivating giants, who prove being big comes with enormous challenges. Narrated by Tom Hiddleston.
value.heroDescription: Meet nature’s most mesmerizing giants.

value.title: Tetris
value.description: Based on the true story of American video game salesman Henk Rogers (Taron Egerton) and his discovery of Tetris in 1988. When he sets out to bring the game to the world, he enters a dangerous web of lies and corruption behind the Iron Curtain.
value.heroDescription: In this gripping story behind the game, a scrappy salesman sets out for success—and enters a web of lies.

value.title: Extrapolations
value.description: Eight interconnected stories told over 33 years explore how our planet’s changing climate will affect family, work, faith—and survival.
value.heroDescription: Eight all-star stories explore our planet’s fate.

value.title: Monster Factory
value.description: Welcome to The World Famous Monster Factory, a school where spandex-clad misfits escape the confines of everyday life to chase the dream of going pro.
value.heroDescription: Aspiring pro wrestlers chase their dreams.

value.title: Hello Tomorrow!
value.description: In a retro-futuristic world, charismatic salesman Jack Billings (Emmy® winner Billy Crudup) leads a team of fellow sales associates determined to revitalize their customers’ lives by hawking timeshares on the moon.
value.heroDescription: Billy Crudup is Jack, and he wants to sell you a timeshare…on the moon.

value.title: Make or Break
value.description: Dive into the world of pro surfing as the best in the sport travel the globe to compete for the World Championship title. With unprecedented access, this docuseries captures the athletes’ lives on tour and the sacrifices they make to get to the top.
value.heroDescription: Follow the best in pro surfing as they vie for the World Championship title.

value.title: Dear Edward
value.description: A 12-year-old boy becomes the lone survivor of a plane crash. As he and others affected by the tragedy try to make sense of what happened, unexpected friendships, romances, and communities are formed.
value.heroDescription: Connie Britton befriends a boy who’s the lone survivor of a plane crash.

value.title: Truth Be Told
value.description: Descend into the world of true-crime podcasts. This NAACP Image Award–winning drama stars Octavia Spencer as a podcaster who risks everything—including her life—to pursue truth and justice.
value.heroDescription: Octavia Spencer is a true-crime podcaster who risks it all for the truth.

value.title: Super League: The War for Football
value.description: The past, present, and future of European football collide when plans for a breakaway league emerge, leaving the game’s most powerful leaders to defend—or upend—the traditions of the sport.
value.heroDescription: A shocking proposal leads to a shake-up.

value.title: The Boy, the Mole, the Fox and the Horse
value.description: 2023 Oscar® winner: Best Animated Short Film. Charlie Mackesy’s bestseller comes to life in this beautifully animated film from NoneMore and Bad Robot Productions. Follow the unlikely bond between four friends on their journey to find home.
value.heroDescription: A heartwarming tale of kindness, friendship and love.

value.title: Emancipation
value.description: Inspired by the gripping true story of a man who would do anything for his family—and for freedom. When Peter, an enslaved man, risks his life to escape and return to his family, he embarks on a perilous journey of love and endurance.
value.heroDescription: An enslaved man risks his life on a treacherous journey to reunite with his family.

value.title: Little America
value.description: From the director and Oscar®-winning writer of CODA, Little America is an anthology series that observes the funny, romantic, heartfelt, inspiring, and surprising stories of immigrants in America.
value.heroDescription: The funny, heartfelt, and inspiring stories of immigrants in America.

value.title: Circuit Breakers
value.description: In this sci-fi anthology series, curiosity leads to chaos when students in the near future experience mysterious events.
value.heroDescription: Curiosity leads to chaos in a kids sci-fi anthology series.

value.title: The Mosquito Coast
value.description: Allie Fox—a brilliant inventor and stubborn idealist—uproots his family for a dangerous quest through Mexico to flee the U.S. government and find safety.
value.heroDescription: A father uproots his family for a dangerous quest.

value.title: Louis Armstrong's Black & Blues
value.description: Never-before-heard personal recordings and archival footage tell the story of Louis Armstrong’s life from his perspective. From musical phenom to civil rights activist to world-renowned artist, this illuminating film shows sides of Armstrong few have seen.
value.heroDescription: A deeply personal look at the jazz legend’s life—told in his own words.

value.title: Shantaram
value.description: Escaped convict Lin Ford flees to the teeming streets of 1980s Bombay, looking to disappear. Working as a medic for the city’s poor and neglected, Lin finds unexpected love, connection, and courage on the long road to redemption.
value.heroDescription: Charlie Hunnam is an escaped convict on the run in 1980s India.

value.title: Wolfboy and the Everything Factory
value.description: William Wolfe is no ordinary human boy. Down in the magical spryte realm of the Everything Factory, he’s Wolfboy. And with his new spryte friends, he learns his vivid imagination and limitless creativity have the power to change the world.
value.heroDescription: A young boy unleashes his creative powers with the help of magical friends.

value.title: Sidney
value.description: From producer Oprah Winfrey, this revealing documentary honors the legendary Sidney Poitier—iconic actor, filmmaker, and civil rights activist. Featuring interviews with Denzel Washington, Spike Lee, Barbra Streisand, and more.
value.heroDescription: Celebrate the life and legacy of the iconic Sidney Poitier.

value.title: Central Park
value.description: In this animated musical comedy, Owen Tillerman and his family live an unconventional life in New York's bustling Central Park, which Owen manages. Now, they'll have to fend off a wealthy hotel heiress who wants to turn the park into condos.
value.heroDescription: Take a musical walk in the park with the Tillerman family.

value.title: Life by Ella
value.description: After a life-changing experience, 13-year-old Ella is eager to seize the day. As she learns to appreciate each moment, she faces the fears that once defined her—and encourages others to do the same.
value.heroDescription: Join Ella on her quest to make every day meaningful.

value.title: Five Days at Memorial
value.description: Based on actual events from Hurricane Katrina. When the floodwaters rose, power failed, and heat soared, exhausted caregivers at a New Orleans hospital were forced to make profound, heart-wrenching decisions.
value.heroDescription: A hospital besieged during Hurricane Katrina reveals the disaster’s toll.

value.title: Best Foot Forward
value.description: Josh Dubin is thrilled to switch from homeschool to public school, and being the only kid with a prosthetic leg is a challenge he’s ready to face. As he carves out a place among his peers, his friends and family are with him every step of the way.
value.heroDescription: Twelve-year-old amputee Josh is ready to take on public school.

value.title: Black Bird
value.description: Inspired by actual events. As Jimmy Keene begins a 10-year prison sentence, he gets an incredible offer: If he can elicit a confession from suspected killer Larry Hall, Jimmy will be freed. Completing this mission becomes the challenge of a lifetime.
value.heroDescription: A shocking crime saga inspired by actual events.

value.title: The Essex Serpent
value.description: London widow Cora Seaborne moves to Essex to investigate reports of a mythical serpent. She forms a surprising bond of science and skepticism with the local vicar—but when tragedy strikes, locals accuse her of attracting the creature.
value.heroDescription: A London widow moves to Essex to investigate a mythical creature.

value.title: The Big Conn
value.description: Eric C. Conn was a lawyer living a little too large in eastern Kentucky…until two whistleblowers realized he was at the center of government fraud worth over half a billion dollars, one of the largest in U.S. history. And that was just the beginning.
value.heroDescription: The true story of one of the largest government frauds in history.

value.title: The Long Game: Bigger Than Basketball
value.description: Makur Maker was a five-star NBA prospect headed to the Draft—until an unexpected detour led him to Howard University. This inspiring docuseries follows Makur’s journey and his determination to rewrite his story with the help of his family.

value.title: Roar
value.description: Featuring an all-star cast, this genre-bending anthology series weaves together eight darkly comedic feminist fables that take unexpected approaches to subjects like gender roles, autonomy, and identity.
value.heroDescription: Explore eight darkly funny fables in this all-star anthology.

value.title: WeCrashed
value.description: Inspired by actual events—and the love story at the center of it all. WeWork grew from a single coworking space into a global brand worth $47 billion in under a decade. Then, in less than a year, its valuation dropped $40 billion. What happened?
value.heroDescription: Jared Leto and Anne Hathaway star in a series inspired by actual events.

value.title: The Last Days of Ptolemy Grey
value.description: Suddenly left without his trusted caretaker, Ptolemy Grey is assigned to the care of orphaned teenager Robyn. When they learn about a treatment that will restore Ptolemy’s dementia-addled memories, it begins a journey toward shocking truths.
value.heroDescription: Dive into a man’s lost memories in this gripping series about life and legacy.

value.title: Dear...
value.description: One person’s story can change the world. From Emmy®-winning filmmaker R.J. Cutler, this docuseries profiles game-changing icons and the people whose lives they’ve inspired.

value.title: Lincoln’s Dilemma
value.description: Discover a side of Abraham Lincoln you’ve never seen before. In this four-part docuseries, a diverse panel of historians and rare archival materials offer a more nuanced look into the man dubbed the Great Emancipator.
value.heroDescription: Discover a side of Abraham Lincoln you’ve never seen before.

value.title: Suspicion
value.description: Four ordinary Brits are accused of kidnapping the son of a prominent U.S. media mogul. They embark on a desperate race against time to prove their innocence, but will anyone believe them—and are they telling the truth?
value.heroDescription: Four people race against time after being accused of a kidnapping.

value.title: The Tragedy of Macbeth
value.description: Nominated for 3 Oscars®, including Best Actor. Denzel Washington and Frances McDormand star in Joel Coen’s bold and fierce adaptation—a tale of murder, madness, ambition, and wrathful cunning.
value.heroDescription: Shakespeare’s tale of murder, madness, ambition, and wrathful cunning.

value.title: El Deafo
value.description: Going to school and making new friends can be tough. Having to do both while wearing a bulky hearing aid on your chest? That takes superpowers! With a little help from her superhero alter ego, El Deafo, Cece learns to embrace her differences.
value.heroDescription: After losing her hearing, Cece learns what makes you different can make you super.

value.title: Swan Song
value.description: In the near future, Cameron Turner is diagnosed with a terminal illness. Presented with an experimental solution to shield his wife and son from grief, he grapples with altering their fate in this thought-provoking exploration of love, loss, and sacrifice.
value.heroDescription: Mahershala Ali grapples with altering his family’s fate in a tale of love and loss.

value.title: For Auld Lang Syne
value.description: After finding out her grandmother won’t be visiting for Christmas, Lucy decides to cheer herself up by throwing the ultimate New Year’s Eve party. Meanwhile, Charlie Brown tries to fulfill one of his resolutions before the clock strikes midnight.
value.heroDescription: Charlie Brown races to fulfil his New Year’s resolution before midnight.
